company_name: China CITIC Financial Asset Management Co., Ltd. (formerly China Huarong Asset Management)
model: State AMC FCFE at cost of equity (engine route): net debt zero, capital retention on asset growth charged as capex, equity-accounted bank earnings haircut, AT1 perpetual coupon charged in the flow

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E 'total segment income' = total income + share of results of associates and JVs (the Group's own segment-income definition; FY2025 actual 61,699 + 18,777 = 80,476, matching the RMB80.5bn in the Analysis). H1 2026 actual 14,894.5 + 11,056.9 = 25,951 (interim p.7). H2 2026E ~28,000: associates ~10.5bn plus total income ~17.5bn; H2 2025's 40.3bn carried 15.4bn of fair-value gains on other financial assets that are not repeated. FY2025 underlying (ex the 21.3bn CEB Bank bargain-purchase gain) was ~59bn.
inputs.share_count_basis: 80,246,679 thousand shares of RMB1.00 par at 30 June 2026 = 44,884.4m Domestic Shares + 35,362.3m H Shares (interim p.2500/5042); one economic class, so the per-share value applies to the H share quoted in HKD. Basic = diluted EPS (RMB0.075 H1 2026); no share scheme, no convertibles. Held FLAT. The real dilution risk is a CITIC Group/MOF recapitalisation at a discount to book as in 2021 (39,070m -> 80,247m shares at RMB1.02); not modelled, carried in the bear weight.
inputs.debt_cash_note: Financial institution: borrowings RMB849.4bn, central-bank borrowings 4.2bn, placements 2.0bn and repos 1.5bn at 30 June 2026 (interim p.8) are the funding book of a 20x-levered distressed-asset balance sheet, and deposits with financial institutions (110.0bn) are liquidity, not surplus. Interest expense (13.0bn H1 2026) is charged inside the pre-tax margin. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route; nothing is bridged after the flows. The Metrics.csv total_debt (RMB1,025bn) and cash (111.6bn) are retained there for the record.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE: profit attributable to ORDINARY shareholders ~12.2bn (H1 2026 6,018 after the 843m perpetual coupon, annualised; PBT ~11bn plus deferred-tax credits and NCI loss absorption) LESS capital retained to hold group equity/assets at ~5.0% on ~6% asset growth (0.05 x 0.062 x 1,090bn = 3.4bn) LESS the non-cash half of equity-accounted bank earnings (associates' share ~21bn, ~50% retained by BOC/CITIC Ltd/CEB, valued at the ~0.5x book the market pays for those banks = 5.3bn). Reported OCF - capex (FY2025 16,761; H1 2026 32,403) is borrowing and distressed-asset acquisition/disposal flow and is not used.
inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero: no share-based payment scheme disclosed in the FY2018-FY2025 annual reports or the 2026 interim; basic = diluted EPS every period; StockBasedComp and ShareRepurchases blank/zero in the CSV. House and street bases coincide; band_position is degenerate (null).
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts CNY (model; the Group reports in RMB) to HKD (H-share quote): CNYHKD=X 1.175 at ~2026-10-22T05:13Z, Yahoo Finance chart API. No A-share listing, so no dual-listing parity check; the H share is the only quoted class.
inputs.book_value_note: Equity attributable to equity holders RMB65,955m at 30 June 2026 includes RMB19,900m of 2022 undated capital bonds (AT1, 4.34% coupon, reset June 2027, distribution stopper on ordinary dividends). Ordinary book = 46,055m = RMB0.574/share (~HKD0.67). NCI is NEGATIVE (-9,428m: subsidiaries' accumulated losses borne by minorities). Interests in associates and JVs are carried at 288,303m (equity method, including bargain-purchase gains of 21.8bn on CITIC Ltd and 21.3bn on CEB Bank booked through income in 2024-25) against a disclosed fair value of listed associates of 124,387m (interim note 22). Marked to market, ordinary equity is roughly -RMB100bn: the H share's value rests on the state-backed going concern and the earnings stream, not on NAV, which is why a NAV route was rejected.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity 13.0% base (12.0% bull, 14.0% bear), built on CNY flows: 10y CGB ~1.8%, China ERP ~6.5% at a levered-financial beta ~1.3 (~10.3%), plus ~2.7pt company-specific premium for (i) wholesale funding at ~20x assets/equity with no deposit franchise, (ii) opaque level-3 distressed-asset marks after RMB300bn+ of impairments in 2020-25, (iii) the Lai Xiaomin governance legacy and July 2026 chairman turnover, (iv) no distributable profits at the parent and an AT1 distribution stopper, so no cash returns for years, (v) the associate mark-to-market hole. Folder peers: CCB 9.5%, CITIC Bank 10.5%, Zheshang 11.0%; a state AMC that cannot pay a dividend sits 2-2.5pt above a joint-stock bank.
inputs.lease_treatment: IFRS 16 lease liabilities RMB366m, repayments ~200m/yr; immaterial against a RMB1.1tn balance sheet, left inside operating expenses in the pre-tax margin. No separate lease charge.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI is a net LOSS absorber (-334m H1 2026, -1,689m FY2025) so profit attributable to equity holders exceeds group profit. The tax-rate path assumes this benefit fades to zero by FY2029 rather than perpetuating it; nothing is deducted for NCI after the flows.
inputs.notes: MODEL: FCFE at cost of equity via the engine (bank/financial route per dcf-methods SKILL.md), not an owner-FCF DCF: EBITDA/FCF/net debt do not exist in the operating sense for a distressed-asset AMC whose borrowings are its working inventory. Mapping: revenue = total segment income (incl. associates); ebitda_margin = pre-tax margin after interest expense, operating expenses and impairments; cash_tax_rate = income tax + AT1 coupon - NCI loss absorption, as a % of PBT; capex = capital retention (AMC equity/assets held at ~5% on asset growth) + the non-cash half of equity-accounted associate earnings valued at ~0.5x book; D&A, SBC, leases and working capital zero. The earnings engine is now the equity-accounted stakes: share of associates 18.8bn FY2025 / 11.1bn H1 2026 against a core AMC that was loss-making before associates in both periods (total income less total expenses: -10.4bn FY2025, -5.8bn H1 2026). The single swing variable is the impairment run-rate (ECL + other: 74bn FY2024, 38bn FY2025, 5.7bn H1 2026 with H2 historically heavier). Dividends: none since 2021, none proposed for FY2024/FY2025 ('no distributable profits'), no interim 2026; the FCFE here is capacity, not payout. Perpetual bonds (19.9bn) are charged through the coupon in the flow and NOT deducted from equity as well.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: equity-accounted bank earnings growing ~4-5% (BOC/CITIC Ltd/CEB book growth) blended with core AMC asset growth of ~6% slowing to ~3%; historical series unusable as a trend
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (27.9%) is the 2021 RMB42bn CITIC-led recapitalisation (18.2bn -> 61.5bn), not compounding; revenue 3yr CAGR (18.6%) is a rebound from the FY2022 trough (36.9bn) and includes 43bn of bargain-purchase gains in FY2024-25; EPS was negative in FY2020 and FY2022 so CAGRs are undefined. Total income (CSV revenue): FY2020 76,508 -> FY2025 61,699; FY2022 36,933 -> FY2025 61,699. Equity: FY2020 18,155 -> FY2025 62,235; FY2022 49,353 -> FY2025 62,235.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs not computed: reported OCF/FCF for a financial is funding flow noise (FY2019 +80bn, FY2022 -34bn, FY2024 +96bn). Ordinary EPS path: FY2023 0.01, FY2024 0.11, FY2025 0.127, H1 2026 0.075.

base.growth_rationale: Total segment income +5% for four years then 4% and 3%: associates' share grows with Chinese bank book growth (~5%), core AMC income grows with distressed-asset acquisitions (sector volumes +22% in 2025 per Fitch, assets +6.2% in H1 2026) net of a shrinking legacy book and falling asset yields.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax margin on total segment income after interest expense, opex and impairments. FY2026E ~20.4% (H1 2026 21.2%: PBT 5,499 on 25,951). Rises to 27% as (i) interest expense keeps falling with funding cost (-9.6% YoY in H1 2026 on a bigger book, 3.1% blended cost), (ii) impairments settle at ~10-12bn/yr versus 38bn FY2025, (iii) associates' contribution (zero-cost line) grows. FY2025 underlying margin ex the CEB gain was negative, so this path assumes the 2023-25 clean-up is largely done.
base.capex_rationale: Capital retention, two parts. (a) AMC capital: group equity/assets held at ~5.0% (CAR 15.71% vs 12.5% minimum at the Company; leverage 7.7:1) on asset growth 6% slowing to 3% = 3.5bn FY2027 -> 2.6bn FY2036. (b) Non-cash associate earnings: ~50% of the equity-accounted share is retained by BOC/CITIC Ltd/CEB; it is charged here at 50% of that (the retained half valued at the ~0.5x book the market pays for those banks) = 5.5bn FY2027 -> 7.2bn FY2036. Total 9.0bn (16% of revenue) falling to ~9.8bn (12%).
base.tax_rationale: Charge on PBT = income tax + AT1 coupon - NCI loss absorption. FY2024-26 show net tax CREDITS (deferred-tax recognition on legacy losses; DTA 25.8bn) and NCI losses of 0.3-2.4bn/yr, while cash tax paid runs 3-5bn/yr at subsidiaries. Path starts at 8% (credits and NCI still offsetting the 0.86bn perpetual coupon) and converges on 30% = 25% statutory + ~3-4pt coupon (reset lower in June 2027) once the DTA is used and NCI losses stop.
base.terminal_note: Gordon 1.03/0.10 = 10.3x FCFE; the 18x cap does not bind.
base.narrative: The post-bailout AMC stabilises: impairments normalise to ~10-12bn/yr, funding cost keeps falling, the BOC/CITIC Ltd/CEB stakes compound at bank-book rates, and FCFE emerges from ~2bn to ~5-6bn/yr over a decade while the parent rebuilds distributable reserves. No dividend before ~FY2029.

bull.growth_rationale: Property/LGFV resolution volumes keep the acquisition book growing high-single digits with policy funding; associates' earnings grow 5-6%; CITIC Group ecosystem sourcing lifts disposal gains.
bull.margin_rationale: Impairments fall to 6-8bn/yr (legacy book fully reserved), funding cost drops below 3% on the Fitch BBB+ trajectory, fair-value marks on the distressed book turn positive as property stabilises. Pre-tax margin reaches 33% - close to Cinda's pre-2020 level.
bull.capex_rationale: Same construction; associate payout ratios rise toward 35% and the retained portion is valued at 0.75x book (bank re-rating), so the non-cash charge is ~25% of the associate share; AMC capital retention on 7% then 4% asset growth.
bull.tax_rationale: DTA utilisation runs longer; perpetual coupon reset to ~3% in June 2027 shrinks the AT1 charge to ~2pt of PBT.
bull.narrative: The CITIC turnaround completes: a clean, growing policy AMC earning 25%+ on ordinary equity, dividends resume by FY2028, the governance discount closes toward Cinda's and the market pays for the equity-accounted bank earnings at near book.

bear.growth_rationale: Core AMC income stalls as asset yields fall faster than the book grows; bank associates' earnings flat under NIM compression.
bear.margin_rationale: A second impairment wave on property/LGFV exposure in FY2027-28 (20-25bn/yr, as in FY2023 and FY2025) and a mark-down of the FVTPL distressed book pushes the pre-tax margin to 14-15%, then a partial recovery to 18%. FY2025 underlying margin ex the CEB gain was negative, so this is not an extreme case.
bear.capex_rationale: Lower asset growth needs less AMC capital, but associates' retained earnings are valued at the current ~0.43x fair-value/carrying ratio, so the non-cash charge stays near 55-60% of the retained half. In practice this is the scenario where capital is replenished by a discounted CITIC Group/MOF placement that dilutes the H share, which the flat share count cannot show.
bear.tax_rationale: Cash tax at profitable subsidiaries cannot be sheltered by parent losses (FY2025 cash tax 4.6bn on PBT 8.3bn; H1 2026 3.3bn on 5.5bn), DTA recognition stops, NCI losses end; AT1 coupon fixed against a smaller PBT.
bear.narrative: A property/LGFV relapse: the core AMC book needs another provisioning cycle, cash FCFE stays around zero for the decade, and the associate stakes - carried at 2.3x their market value - are what the state ultimately looks through to. Ordinary H-share equity is worth little more than its option on a policy-backed recovery.

scenario_narratives.base: Post-bailout normalisation under CITIC Group: impairments settle at 10-12bn/yr, funding cost keeps falling, the BOC/CITIC Ltd/CEB stakes compound at bank-book rates, ordinary profit grows mid-single digits from ~12bn and FCFE (after capital retention and the non-cash half of associate earnings) builds from ~2bn to ~5-6bn by FY2036. No dividend before ~FY2029 while the parent rebuilds distributable reserves.
scenario_narratives.bull: The turnaround completes: legacy book fully reserved, funding below 3%, pre-tax margin to 33%, dividends resume by FY2028 and the governance discount closes toward Cinda's; equity-accounted bank earnings are valued near book.
scenario_narratives.bear: Property/LGFV relapse forces a second provisioning cycle; cash FCFE stays near zero for a decade and capital is replenished by a discounted state placement. The H share is worth little beyond its policy-backed recovery option.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 35%, as for CITIC Bank (0998.HK) and above the house default: the core AMC was loss-making before associates in both FY2025 and H1 2026; impairments have been 32-74bn in each of FY2023-25 with H2 historically heavier than H1; associates are carried at 288bn against a disclosed listed fair value of 124bn; the parent has no distributable profits and an AT1 distribution stopper; the 2021 recapitalisation doubled the share count at RMB1.02. Bull 20%: the H1 2026 clean half (PBT +9%, impairments -70% YoY, interest expense -10%) and the Fitch upgrade trajectory are real, but a state policy vehicle's upside accrues first to the mandate. Base 45%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC-zero): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Discount the flow that actually accrues to the ordinary H-share - profit after tax, AT1 coupon and minorities, less the capital a 20x-levered AMC must retain and less the non-cash portion of equity-accounted bank earnings - at a cost of equity that charges the wholesale funding, the opacity of distressed-asset marks, the governance legacy and the absence of any distributable profit. Book value is not the anchor: stated ordinary book (RMB0.574/share) is held up by associate carrying values 2.3x their market value, and marked to market it is negative; nor is reported P/E (~3.5-4x), because the earnings are two-thirds equity-accounted and tax-credit-assisted. The valuation is therefore an earnings-capacity view with a heavy bear weight, not a NAV.
key_risks_to_valuation: Impairment run-rate: every 10bn/yr of additional ECL is ~RMB0.08/share of annual ordinary profit against FY2026E ~0.15

Associate carrying values (288bn) vs listed fair value (124bn): any impairment test failure or loss of 'significant influence' (board seats at BOC, CITIC Ltd, CEB) would crystallise a 100bn+ hit to book and the AT1 non-viability trigger
Dilutive recapitalisation: 2021 precedent doubled the share count; the flat count in all scenarios understates bear-case damage
Funding access and cost: 849bn of borrowings rolling at ~3.1%; a spread shock of 50bp is ~4bn/yr, a third of ordinary profit
Policy direction: the AMC's deal flow, pricing and funding are set by the state; minority H-shareholders are residual to the mandate
Governance: chairman resigned July 2026, successor unconfirmed; the Lai Xiaomin legacy keeps the regulatory premium in the discount rate
Deferred tax asset (25.8bn) recognition is a judgment that flatters reported profit; cash taxes paid run 3-5bn/yr

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX intraday); 52-week range HKD 0.54-1.09
data_sources.financials: 2026 Interim Report (H1 2026, unaudited, RMB millions: income statement p.7, balance sheet p.8, ratios p.9, capital adequacy p.51, note 22 associates incl. fair value of listed companies, note 32 perpetual bonds); 2025 Annual Report (financial summary pp.11-14, segment results 8.2.1.4, note 16 dividends, capital adequacy 8.5); Metrics.csv FY2016-H1 2026; kpis table (ImpairmentLosses, InterestExpense, IncomeFromDistressedDebtAssets, CashTaxesPaid)
data_sources.qualitative: 2799.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-22): Big Four AMC position, CITIC restructuring, property/LGFV exposure, governance history, H1 2026 results and chairman resignation
